claims.claim: INFQ's current risk evidence supports a commercialization-stage tension rather than a present structural blocker: fast reported growth and liquidity coexist with operating losses larger than quarterly revenue and forward technical milestones.

Government awards, partner integrations and technical milestones should not be treated as equivalent to recurring commercial revenue; customer deployment economics and independent milestone verification remain falsification paths.

risks: Commercial proof can lag technical and partnership milestones.
Revenue-recognition update increases the value of cash and contract-level corroboration.
Fault-tolerant utility depends on successor bottlenecks including error correction, control fidelity, scaling and workload economics.

contradictions.statement: Commercialization metrics are improving while utility-scale fault-tolerant execution remains forward-looking.
contradictions.disposition: real commercialization-stage tension; monitor and quantify rather than block

unknowns: Independent verification of the targeted logical-qubit milestone and customer economics.
Customer concentration, normalized gross margins and durable cash burn remain Alpha-owned underwriting inputs.
falsifiers: Independent evidence that targeted logical-qubit milestones are not reproducible or do not yield economically useful customer workloads.
Contract-level evidence showing awards/partnerships fail to convert into repeatable commercial deployments.
Liquidity deterioration or dilution materially outpacing commercial scaling.
recommendedNextState: council-alpha reuses source-addressed risk/falsifier evidence when constructing its owned numeric risk and confidence records; deep-resolver owns any remaining material contradiction disposition
